coherence: All covering chunks at midpoint of first 10 sorted selected PDF pages; report mean within position, then mean over 10 positions.
grounding: All five fixed test questions for every strategy, top-3 union evidence.
metadata: All five fixed test questions x top-3 x three strategies.
human_review_status: AI review recorded; student confirmation pending
reviewer: Codex AI assistant; not independent human/student sign-off
rating_method: AI read each exported coherence sample and all five test top-3 for A/B/C. Ratings use the stated 0-2 rubric with case-specific reasons, not a conversion from Hit@3. Metadata was checked against PDF text, page mapping and offsets. Same assistant helped build the pipeline and saw retrieval scores; review is unblinded and may be biased.
legacy_column_note: human_correct is a legacy column name; reviewer/review_method/student_confirmed identify the actual AI assessment.
retrieval_note: Frozen gold and strict metrics unchanged; q17 B/C has equivalent evidence at rank 1, described separately rather than silently changing test gold.

retrieval_adjudication.method: Post-hoc AI reading of every unique question/chunk pair, reused only when the same text and question reappear in another strategy. Each rank retains decision/reason; accepted evidence is quoted and checked inside one chunk and the source. Question/text hashes detect stale labels.
retrieval_adjudication.limitations: Unblinded AI review by the same assistant that helped author the experiment; student confirmation not recorded. Not a new test set, not used to change the original strategy selection.
retrieval_adjudication.outputs: metrics.csv remains strict; metrics_adjudicated.csv is separate and explicitly labeled
